scenarioTitle: Make and Govern Human Decisions — the accessible, policy-bound decision queue

criteria.statement: Authorized humans see a complete, prioritized decision queue with the context to decide.
criteria.evidence: queue lists 5 decisions in non-increasing priority order, each with requested action + risk + impact + expiry
criteria.negativeControl: if any row lost its requestedAction/riskTier the completeness check flips false

criteria.statement: A decision the human is authorized to act on offers the full attributable action set.
criteria.evidence: authorized row actionable=true; allowedActions=[approve, deny, request_changes, delegate]
criteria.negativeControl: the expired + conflicted rows carry an EMPTY allowedActions set (not actionable)

criteria.statement: A separation-of-duties conflict blocks the action and is stated in text, never hidden.
criteria.evidence: conflicted row actionable=false; conflicts=[separation-of-duties: requester cannot approve their own access grant]
criteria.negativeControl: the authorized row has zero conflicts and is actionable — the SoD block is scenario-specific

criteria.statement: Authority may be delegated within a bounded window to a distinct recipient; lapse is an accountability effect.
criteria.evidence: active delegation 019c9669-288c-7e4a-8f5f-4921c249799c in-window (valid 1772046400000→1772071600000, now 1772050000000); expired delegation 019c9669-288e-7c25-bef2-37dd691363ae lapsed
criteria.negativeControl: the expired delegation is past its window (status="expired") — an unbounded grant would still be "active"

criteria.statement: A decision past its deadline is expired and escalated — never silently closed or actioned.
criteria.negativeControl: the in-window authorized package is NOT expired (decisionIsExpired=false)

criteria.statement: Every decision outcome carries an attributable, non-empty reason (code + text).
criteria.negativeControl: makeReason rejects an empty/blank reason text — an unattributed outcome cannot be constructed

criteria.statement: Break-glass can stop an operation but never confers decision authority, and its post-event review stays open until completed.
criteria.evidence: break-glass event 019c9669-2890-785b-a3bf-527b1206d54b reviewComplete=false; consequence states stop will NOT approve/grant authority
criteria.negativeControl: a completed review would set reviewComplete=true + a reviewer — the open-review alert only fires while OPEN
